name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) matches the task: whenever the ball is out of the way, the key must be carried then or picked up later. Since blocker_moved is a lasting condition that can turn false again, the machine re-opens the obligation whenever the key is dropped while the ball is still moved, which captures 'at every moment'. The 'whenever' wording makes this a rule-only task, so the empty FINAL_STATES and its warning are valid.

texts: Whenever the ball is out of the way of the door, the agent must be carrying the matching key then or pick it up later.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
